AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F3 + F6):

**F3 (T7 scope)**: T7's 5 concerns (imports, pipeline, threshold branching, OVER_BOUND emit, config validation) are tightly coupled — splitting would violate Gate 2 (codebase green per task). Keep T7 as a single task but add EXPLICIT sub-AC items for each concern to ensure complete coverage:

**F6 (max_calls constraint)**: Config validation must also check max_calls >= max_files + 1 (one aggregation pass on top of N dispatches). Emit ValueError at runner init when violated.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] Config validation: max_calls >= max_files + 1; raises at init
  Verify: grep -qE 'max_calls.*max_files.*\+ 1|max_calls.*>= max_files' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] OVER_BOUND status enum addition is in a single line/block (for surgical-edit auditability)
  Verify: grep -c 'OVER_BOUND' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py | awk '{exit ($1>=2?0:1)}'  # at least definition + usage
